title: E155 Final Project
text: We will build a two-player infrared laser tag system in which each player carries a blaster and a wearable target, both driven by one E155 development board (iCE40 UP5K FPGA + STM32L432KC MCU). Pulling the trigger fires a coded IR packet; when another player’s receivers decode it, their unit registers a hit, flashes its LEDs, plays a sound effect, and reports the hit over Wi-Fi to a laptop scoreboard.

title: Project Proposal Specs
text:
Bill of materials included with list of all items needed for the project
Project lists specifications for design
Identifies the riskiest element of the project





Bill of materials includes part numbers, quantities, and prices for all components including shipping and taxes. Prices for components available in the stock room should be indicated as “stockroom”.
Completely clear what the project must do to meet specs.
Rough timeline included which lists the tasks which need to be completed, the order in which they will be pursued, the time they are expected to take, and how the tasks will be divided among the team members.
Calculation of performance critical parameters is present.
Writing is well organized and no grammar or spelling issues.
